summary: Nakamoto Inc., through its subsidiary, restructured a secured loan with Kraken on June 5, 2026, under a Master Loan Agreement. The new term sheet provides a 210M USDT principal loan secured by 4,405 Bitcoin in a control and trading account held by an affiliate custodian. The loan matures in two tranches: 105M USDT on Dec 4, 2026, and 105M USDT on June 30, 2027, with early return rights after 30 days' notice. The fee is 7.75% p.a. if at least 2,000 Bitcoin remains in the trading wallet, else 8% p.a. This is a routine debt restructuring, not a special situation. What to watch: collateral coverage and fee adjustments if Bitcoin volatility impacts collateral.
